result.summary: The pedestrian environment features high-visibility continental crosswalks and wide sidewalks in a dense commercial district. Safety is hindered by a large construction shed obstructing the sidewalk and a vehicle parked near the crosswalk, which creates sightline issues.

hazards.name: Construction Scaffolding
hazards.description: A large construction shed and scaffolding block a significant portion of the sidewalk, narrowing the path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street along the building facade.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vehicle
hazards.description: A vehicle is positioned very close to the crosswalk, significantly obstructing the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, adjacent to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking or standing zones near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Protected Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Ensure that construction sites provide a clear, ADA-compliant, and protected walkway that does not force pedestrians into the roadway.

result.summary: A high-density urban intersection featuring wide multi-lane roadways and high-visibility continental crosswalks. While standard pedestrian infrastructure like signals and curb ramps are present, the significant crossing distance increases pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period during the crossing.

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Risk
hazards.description: Multiple travel lanes in the same direction increase the risk of a pedestrian being struck by a vehicle in one lane after another has stopped.
hazards.location_in_image: Approaching lanes on the right side of the image

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Modify signal timing to provide pedestrians with a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Incorporate a median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-density commercial intersection with standard pedestrian infrastructure including zebra-marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. While the environment is well-maintained, pedestrians face exposure across multiple travel lanes without physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands.

hazards.name: Turning vehicle conflict
hazards.description: Vehicles turning at the intersection may conflict with pedestrians in the crosswalk, particularly with the high volume of foot traffic visible.

hazards.name: Pedestrian exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-crossing refuge.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light, reducing turning conflicts.

result.summary: The image shows a high-density commercial urban environment with a wide roadway featuring a buffered bike lane and high-visibility crosswalk markings. While pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present and in good condition, the crossing distance is significant without a median refuge.
